items.title: Gartner (NYSE:IT) exceeds Q3 2026 expectations
items.summary: Research and advisory firm Gartner (NYSE:IT) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, but revenue edged lower by 1.3% year on year to $1.50 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.59 per share was 26.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
